  {"location": "left edge (2018)", "fact": "The line begins at the highest vertical position, just below the 3,500 tick."},
  {"location": "right edge (2023)", "fact": "The line ends at the lowest vertical position, between the 1,500 and 2,000 ticks."},

 ],

  {"location": "x-axis", "fact": "Axis label 'Year' with tick labels 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023."},
  {"location": "2018 point", "fact": "Series value approximately 3,450 (just under 3,500)."},
  {"location": "2020 point", "fact": "Series value approximately 3,100 (just above 3,000)."},
  {"location": "2021 point", "fact": "Series value approximately 2,650 (between 2,500 and 3,000)."},
  {"location": "2022 point", "fact": "Series value approximately 2,300 (between 2,000 and 2,500)."},
  {"location": "2023 point", "fact": "Series value approximately 1,800 (between 1,500 and 2,000)."},

 ],

  "primary_field_label: 'Output trend route'",

 ],
